newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Pensioners smile as stolen false teeth recovered.
newsitem.headline: Pensioners smile as stolen false teeth recovered.

text.p: The mystery surrounding the theft of several sets of false teeth from a Bratislava seniors' home was partially solved when a shoe box containing the dentures was found, the TASR news agency reported on Wednesday.
But TASR added, the thief, who reportedly stole the teeth from their overnight glasses, remained at large.
TASR said that once the box was found, the owners of the teeth were grinning from ear to ear, though some only after trying on several sets to identify which were actually theirs.
